ns2:course.label: Clinical Experience Admin
ns2:course.description: (EOL 464) Direct experience in the study of educational problems of concern to administrators; features an action component whereby the student is provided with opportunities for assuming responsibility for decision making in a live or simulated setting; each student works under the supervision of a professor, and where possible and appropriate, a practicing administrator. May be repeated to a maximum of 12 hours. No more than 4 hours earned at the master's level.
